strings.rb-busted-a-quiet-shoulder/synopsis: A missed hand signal ends in an orderly stop.
strings.rb-busted-a-quiet-shoulder/beat/0: That light was meant for us.
strings.rb-busted-a-quiet-shoulder/beat/2: Engine off. Hands where I can see them.
strings.rb-busted-a-quiet-shoulder/beat/3: I saw the gap. I missed the sign.
strings.rb-busted-a-quiet-shoulder/beat/5: The road will still be here tomorrow.
strings.rb-busted-the-borrowed-excuse/synopsis: A rider blames a helmet radio; their rival declines to play along.
strings.rb-busted-the-borrowed-excuse/beat/1: Your friend said the radio was broken.
strings.rb-busted-the-borrowed-excuse/beat/2: Only when it tells me to slow down.
strings.rb-busted-the-borrowed-excuse/beat/3: It was quite clear from my lane.
strings.rb-busted-the-borrowed-excuse/beat/4: That excuse needs a better mechanic.
strings.rb-busted-one-last-yellow-line/synopsis: A confident pass is reviewed calmly beside the bikes.
strings.rb-busted-one-last-yellow-line/beat/0: I thought the line had opened.
strings.rb-busted-one-last-yellow-line/beat/2: Look behind the bend, not just through it.
strings.rb-busted-one-last-yellow-line/beat/3: You are right. I committed too early.
strings.rb-busted-the-audience-leaves/synopsis: Spectators drift away while a rider accepts responsibility.
strings.rb-busted-the-audience-leaves/beat/1: Give us a little room, please.
strings.rb-busted-the-audience-leaves/beat/3: Then help make the shoulder safe.
strings.rb-busted-no-argument-with-a-light/synop: A patrol check interrupts a private rivalry.
strings.rb-busted-no-argument-with-a-light/beat/: We can settle this at the next straight.
You can settle it after this stop.
Neither of us was watching the mirror.
Two bikes. One safe way home.
strings.rb-busted-a-slower-return/synopsis: The rider takes the consequence and helps clear the lane.
strings.rb-busted-a-slower-return/beat/0: Pull completely clear of the lane.
strings.rb-busted-a-slower-return/beat/1: I can move it from here.
strings.rb-busted-a-slower-return/beat/2: Thank you for keeping the road open.
strings.rb-busted-a-slower-return/beat/3: I should have done that sooner.
strings.rb-busted-a-slower-return/beat/5: Slow enough to notice it this time.
strings.rb-duel-two-lines-one-road/synopsis: A private rivalry develops through three trials, a mistake and a deliberate shared finish.
strings.rb-duel-two-lines-one-road/beat/3: Three bends to the water tower.
strings.rb-duel-two-lines-one-road/beat/5: Then I will try something new.
strings.rb-duel-two-lines-one-road/beat/7: Ash waits half a breath longer.
strings.rb-duel-two-lines-one-road/beat/8: Juno finds daylight near the exit.
strings.rb-duel-two-lines-one-road/beat/11: We have not reached the second bend.
strings.rb-duel-two-lines-one-road/beat/12: A patch of gravel lies in the shadow.
strings.rb-duel-two-lines-one-road/beat/14: They spread out before the narrow section.
strings.rb-duel-two-lines-one-road/beat/15: Juno stays wide of the loose surface.
strings.rb-duel-two-lines-one-road/beat/16: Ash gives up speed to keep a clean line.
strings.rb-duel-two-lines-one-road/beat/19: It did not look like the fast choice.
strings.rb-duel-two-lines-one-road/beat/21: The tower is past the next crest.
strings.rb-duel-two-lines-one-road/beat/22: Both bikes climb toward the last turn.
strings.rb-duel-two-lines-one-road/beat/23: Ash moves early and finds the apex.
strings.rb-duel-two-lines-one-road/beat/24: Juno carries a little too much entry speed.
strings.rb-duel-two-lines-one-road/beat/25: The rear tire skips at the shoulder.
strings.rb-duel-two-lines-one-road/beat/28: All right. Give me a moment.
strings.rb-duel-two-lines-one-road/beat/29: The finish waits beyond the tower.
strings.rb-duel-two-lines-one-road/beat/31: I still want a proper answer.
strings.rb-duel-two-lines-one-road/beat/33: They start together without a signal.
strings.rb-duel-two-lines-one-road/beat/34: This time both riders leave room.
strings.rb-duel-two-lines-one-road/beat/35: The tower passes between their shadows.
strings.rb-duel-two-lines-one-road/beat/38: Next time, you take the outside.
strings.rb-finalwin-the-road-stays-open/synopsis: Finishing the campaign becomes a shared moment and a return to ordinary riding.
strings.rb-finalwin-the-road-stays-open/beat/0: The final marker slips behind the group.
strings.rb-finalwin-the-road-stays-open/beat/1: Nobody reaches for another lap time.
strings.rb-finalwin-the-road-stays-open/beat/2: They leave space for the last rider.
strings.rb-finalwin-the-road-stays-open/beat/5: And enough stories for the winter.
strings.rb-finalwin-the-road-stays-open/beat/6: Keep a few for the next rider.
strings.rb-finalwin-the-road-stays-open/beat/7: The garage light is still on.
strings.rb-finalwin-the-road-stays-open/beat/11: Racing Bois. Thanks for riding with us.
strings.rb-intro-a-road-with-room/synopsis: A newcomer joins a loose crew and chooses a first route.
strings.rb-intro-a-road-with-room/beat/0: The garage opens before the city does.
strings.rb-intro-a-road-with-room/beat/1: A worn map covers the workbench.
strings.rb-intro-a-road-with-room/beat/3: I did not want to miss the first ride.
strings.rb-intro-a-road-with-room/beat/4: The first ride is mostly listening.
strings.rb-intro-a-road-with-room/beat/5: A loose mirror is tightened by hand.
strings.rb-intro-a-road-with-room/beat/6: What do I need to know?
strings.rb-intro-a-road-with-room/beat/7: Where you are going. Who is beside you.
strings.rb-intro-a-road-with-room/beat/8: The crew rolls the bikes into the light.
strings.rb-intro-a-road-with-room/beat/10: Ash waits until the last engine catches.
strings.rb-intro-a-road-with-room/beat/11: Leave a little room for surprise.
strings.rb-intro-a-road-with-room/beat/12: The city gives way to open ground.
strings.rb-intro-a-road-with-room/beat/13: The first bend asks a simple question.
strings.rb-intro-a-road-with-room/beat/14: Nobody answers it quite the same way.
strings.rb-intro-a-road-with-room/beat/15: Racing Bois. Find your own line.
strings.rb-rival-junos-unfinished-map/synopsis: A rider's reputation gives way to the personal reason they return to the road.
strings.rb-rival-junos-unfinished-map/beat/0: Juno is still at the garage after the others leave.
strings.rb-rival-junos-unfinished-map/beat/1: A route card lies beside a cooling engine.
strings.rb-rival-junos-unfinished-map/beat/2: You never put that card away.
strings.rb-rival-junos-unfinished-map/beat/3: There is one section I never got right.
strings.rb-rival-junos-unfinished-map/beat/4: Here, where the road doubles back.
strings.rb-rival-junos-unfinished-map/beat/8: They follow the river out of town.
strings.rb-rival-junos-unfinished-map/beat/9: Juno takes the bends without hurry.
strings.rb-rival-junos-unfinished-map/beat/10: The old marker used to be there.
strings.rb-rival-junos-unfinished-map/beat/11: I learned this road with my brother.
strings.rb-rival-junos-unfinished-map/beat/12: He said the corner would make sense one morning.
strings.rb-rival-junos-unfinished-map/beat/14: Not while I was trying to prove him wrong.
strings.rb-rival-junos-unfinished-map/beat/15: They stand above a quiet stretch of water.
strings.rb-rival-junos-unfinished-map/beat/16: The exit is visible from here.
strings.rb-rival-junos-unfinished-map/beat/17: You cannot see it from the entry.
strings.rb-rival-junos-unfinished-map/beat/20: Juno rolls back to the start of the bend.
strings.rb-rival-junos-unfinished-map/beat/21: The bike settles before the apex.
strings.rb-rival-junos-unfinished-map/beat/22: The remembered exit opens at the right moment.
strings.rb-rival-junos-unfinished-map/beat/26: A good morning for that corner.
strings.rb-rival-junos-unfinished-map/beat/27: A good morning to bring someone along.
strings.rb-rival-junos-unfinished-map/beat/28: The card gains a small, careful mark.
strings.rb-rival-junos-unfinished-map/beat/29: There are still roads left to learn.
strings.rb-level-past-the-first-ridge/synopsis: The group sees a larger world after the first milestone.
strings.rb-level-past-the-first-ridge/beat/0: The old road looks smaller from here.
strings.rb-level-past-the-first-ridge/beat/2: There is a whole district past that ridge.
strings.rb-level-past-the-first-ridge/beat/3: And more people who know its corners.
strings.rb-level-past-the-first-ridge/beat/4: We will listen before we race.
strings.rb-level-city-rhythm/synopsis: A new route calls for different judgment.
strings.rb-level-city-rhythm/beat/1: Less room for an old assumption.
strings.rb-level-city-rhythm/beat/3: Then find our place in it.
strings.rb-level-above-the-weather/synopsis: Climbing into thin air changes the riders' perspective.
strings.rb-level-above-the-weather/beat/0: The air is colder up here.
strings.rb-level-above-the-weather/beat/4: For the road and each other.
strings.rb-level-a-line-beside-the-sea/synopsis: A coast route brings crosswinds and open views.
strings.rb-level-a-line-beside-the-sea/beat/2: I knew you would say that.
strings.rb-level-a-line-beside-the-sea/beat/4: Then let us give this one plenty.
strings.rb-level-orchard-light/synopsis: A familiar skill meets a quieter landscape.
strings.rb-level-orchard-light/beat/3: We are guests on this road.
strings.rb-level-beyond-the-last-stamp/synopsis: A complete route card becomes an invitation to return.
strings.rb-level-beyond-the-last-stamp/beat/2: All the things between the boxes.
strings.rb-level-beyond-the-last-stamp/beat/3: A quieter morning. A cleaner corner.
strings.rb-level-beyond-the-last-stamp/beat/4: A few people worth riding with.
strings.rb-lose-a-better-question/synopsis: The rider replaces an excuse with a useful question.
strings.rb-lose-a-better-question/beat/3: Before the road made the choice for you.
strings.rb-lose-one-breath-late/synopsis: A small hesitation is accepted and understood.
strings.rb-lose-one-breath-late/beat/2: Next time, decide before you arrive.
strings.rb-lose-one-breath-late/beat/4: That is something to take home.
strings.rb-lose-the-patient-rival/synopsis: A rival offers practical advice instead of gloating.
strings.rb-lose-a-mirror-lesson/synopsis: Watching behind made the rider miss what was ahead.
strings.rb-lose-no-shortcut-home/synopsis: The rider chooses to practice the difficult section.
strings.rb-lose-no-shortcut-home/beat/4: I will follow at an easier pace.
strings.rb-lose-the-empty-boast/synopsis: A boast turns into a shared laugh and a new start.
strings.rb-lose-the-empty-boast/beat/0: I may have promised too much.
strings.rb-lose-the-empty-boast/beat/1: Only by an entire finish line.
strings.rb-lose-a-cool-engine/synopsis: The rider learns to stop pushing a tired machine.
strings.rb-lose-a-cool-engine/beat/1: Listen to it before you ask for more.
strings.rb-lose-a-cool-engine/beat/2: You earned a rest, little bike.
strings.rb-lose-a-cool-engine/beat/4: We both needed to hear that.
strings.rb-lose-not-the-whole-story/synopsis: A bad placing does not erase one good decision.
strings.rb-lose-not-the-whole-story/beat/1: You gave that stopped car room.
strings.rb-lose-the-marker/synopsis: The rider chooses a concrete place to improve.
strings.rb-lose-the-marker/beat/1: The one by the bent marker.
strings.rb-lose-the-marker/beat/3: Brake before the shadow next time.
strings.rb-lose-a-finish-worth-keeping/synopsis: A difficult run becomes a foundation for future practice.
strings.rb-lose-a-finish-worth-keeping/beat/0: You stayed with it all the way.
strings.rb-lose-a-finish-worth-keeping/beat/1: It did not feel like enough.
strings.rb-lose-a-finish-worth-keeping/beat/2: Yesterday you would have turned back.
strings.rb-lose-a-finish-worth-keeping/beat/4: And today had a steadier rider.
strings.rb-lose-a-finish-worth-keeping/beat/5: Keep today's line in your head.
strings.rb-showcase-spark-450/synopsis: Short wheelbase, upright bars, a clean everyday stance.
strings.rb-showcase-kestrel/synopsis: A high front profile and narrow tail leave a nimble silhouette.
strings.rb-showcase-rift-250/synopsis: The light chassis keeps the mechanical layout readable.
strings.rb-showcase-jackal/synopsis: A low seat and forward fork establish a stretched cruiser profile.
strings.rb-showcase-ember/synopsis: An exposed frame and simple bodywork put the engine at the center.
strings.rb-showcase-apex/synopsis: Full fairing and an aerodynamic tail define a fast touring shape.
strings.rb-showcase-corvus/synopsis: Angular side panels contrast with a compact instrument cluster.
strings.rb-showcase-viper/synopsis: A forward crouch and broad rear section communicate acceleration.
strings.rb-showcase-rift-750-n/synopsis: Distinct intake and exhaust routing make the boosted variant legible.
strings.rb-showcase-specter/synopsis: A smooth outer shell gives way to detailed mechanical surfaces.
strings.rb-start-cold-hands-warm-engines/synopsi: A calm breath precedes the first launch.
strings.rb-start-a-shared-nod/synopsis: Two rivals acknowledge one another before leaving.
strings.rb-start-wind-check/synopsis: A crosswind changes the riders' starting positions.
strings.rb-start-wind-check/beat/1: Give the outside a little space.
strings.rb-start-the-quiet-grid/synopsis: A noisy group becomes focused at the signal.
strings.rb-start-one-clean-launch/synopsis: A rider avoids repeating an earlier stall.
strings.rb-start-late-light/synopsis: The final sunlight sets a warm tone for the race.
strings.rb-start-late-light/beat/1: Keep the sun out of the mirrors.
strings.rb-start-late-light/beat/3: See you at the far end.
strings.rb-showcase-nightjar/synopsis: Raised controls and balanced proportions suit long late rides.
strings.rb-showcase-cinder-10/synopsis: A sculpted tank anchors an aggressive engine-forward silhouette.
strings.rb-showcase-rift-750/synopsis: The unboosted design keeps its frame and breathing path exposed.
strings.rb-showcase-odyssey/synopsis: A longer seat and relaxed controls put endurance in the profile.
strings.rb-showcase-havoc/synopsis: A compact tail and strong front geometry give a muscular stance.
strings.rb-win-room-at-the-front/synopsis: The winner makes room for the rest of the group.
strings.rb-win-room-at-the-front/beat/4: Good run. Every one of you.
strings.rb-win-room-at-the-front/beat/5: There is room for all of us here.
strings.rb-win-a-glove-across-the-gap/synopsis: Two close competitors reconcile without a speech.
strings.rb-win-the-line-nobody-saw/synopsis: A clever late line becomes the subject of a friendly debate.
strings.rb-win-the-line-nobody-saw/beat/0: Where did you find that exit?
strings.rb-win-the-line-nobody-saw/beat/1: I stopped staring at your rear wheel.
strings.rb-win-the-long-way-pays/synopsis: Patience and an outside pass earn a celebration.
strings.rb-win-the-long-way-pays/beat/0: You stayed outside the whole way.
strings.rb-win-the-long-way-pays/beat/1: There was more room to breathe.
strings.rb-win-the-long-way-pays/beat/3: Sometimes the long line is the clean one.
strings.rb-win-the-long-way-pays/beat/5: Then it was a good race for both of us.
strings.rb-win-crew-first/synopsis: The rider redirects congratulations to the crew.
strings.rb-win-crew-first/beat/1: Ask who fixed the rear brake.
strings.rb-win-crew-first/beat/2: We only handed you a wrench.
strings.rb-win-crew-first/beat/5: All right. We will take it.
strings.rb-win-the-small-victory/synopsis: The winner quietly checks on a rival before celebrating.
strings.rb-win-the-small-victory/beat/0: You came in wide. Everything all right?
strings.rb-win-the-small-victory/beat/1: All right. Just out of road.
strings.rb-win-the-small-victory/beat/3: And another chance to catch you.
strings.rb-win-the-small-victory/beat/5: One good finish at a time.
strings.rb-wreck-count-the-important-parts/synop: The rider checks themselves before the machine.
strings.rb-wreck-count-the-important-parts/beat/: Easy. Stay still for a moment.
Then we can look at the bike.
strings.rb-wreck-a-careful-lift/synopsis: The group coordinates a safe recovery.
strings.rb-wreck-a-careful-lift/beat/0: That is enough road for today.
strings.rb-wreck-a-careful-lift/beat/3: One at the bars. One at the rear.
strings.rb-wreck-a-careful-lift/beat/5: There. Nobody has to prove anything.
strings.rb-wreck-the-missing-hurry/synopsis: A rival refuses to rush a stranded rider.
strings.rb-wreck-the-missing-hurry/beat/0: Go. You will lose the light.
strings.rb-wreck-listen-to-the-silence/synopsis: The stopped engine gives space for an honest assessment.
strings.rb-wreck-listen-to-the-silence/beat/0: I heard it before I felt it.
strings.rb-wreck-listen-to-the-silence/beat/1: Then the next warning is worth hearing.
strings.rb-wreck-listen-to-the-silence/beat/5: That is the part we keep.
strings.rb-wreck-a-clean-way-out/synopsis: The rider prioritizes clearing the road.
strings.rb-wreck-a-clean-way-out/beat/1: Leave the machine for a moment.
strings.rb-wreck-tomorrows-repair/synopsis: A damaged machine becomes a repair plan.
strings.rb-wreck-tomorrows-repair/beat/0: That will need a long evening.
strings.rb-wreck-tomorrows-repair/beat/1: Bars, brake, and a little patience.
